title: run-dev.sh --stats-out pass-through never forwards args and injects a stray empty argument
evidence:
+odin build app -define:PP_DEBUG=true -out:bin/app-dev "${ARGS[@]+}" 2>&1 | head -20 + *) ARGS+=("$1") ;; +# tools/run-dev.sh --stats-out

# pass-through (the app's telemetry flag) + ./bin/app-dev
detail: "${ARGS[@]+}" expands to one empty-string word when ARGS is non-empty (bash-verified), never the args themselves; odin build gets a stray "" argument. Collected args also target the build, never the ./bin/app-dev run, so the documented runtime flag is unreachable.
recommended_fix: Use "${ARGS[@]+"${ARGS[@]}"}" on odin build and pass the collected args to the app invocation (./bin/app-dev "$@"-style), not the compiler.

title: noc_row_right is defined but never called anywhere in the diff
evidence:
+// noc_row_right — right-aligned row (the tabular-figures rule: numerals hold
+noc_row_right :: proc(v: ^View, cur, scroll, visible: i32, txt: string, size: i32, col: rl.Color, w: i32) -> i32 {
detail: The procedure has zero call sites; all right-alignment goes through noc_col instead. Dead code in a file whose header and spec both claim "one key, one surface, zero dead code".
recommended_fix: Delete noc_row_right, or route a panel row through it so the helper is exercised.

title: Queue-row selection hardcodes util 70 while bar colors derive the canon amber threshold
detail: Row inclusion uses a literal 70 (noc_queue_rows takes no cat param) while the bars inside those rows color via cat.balance.warnings.pipe_amber_pct. If balance.json amber changes, rows vanish while their bar would still be amber — the diff's own "never invent ladders" rule is violated.
recommended_fix: Thread cat (or amber_pct) into noc_panel_rows/noc_queue_rows and use the canon threshold for row selection, matching the bar ladder.

title: Stale F-key references contradict the final D ruling (main.odin comment and frozen spec)
evidence:
+		// v2-noc: the F-key debug surface (the merged 5.7 + NOC overlay) draws
+				append(&ictx.events, inp.Device_Event(inp.Key_Press{key = .D}))
+- [ ] `app/input/*.odin` + `app/main.odin` -- D kept as the overlay key (poll gated .D, map .D; F unbound — zero dead code), ... e2e auto-drive (PP_NOC_E2E=1: inject Key_Press{.F} after the polls at frame N, TakeScreenshot on/off, exit)
+- `odin build app -define:PP_DEBUG=true -out:app-debug.bin` -- expected: compiles; F toggles the panel
detail: The key is D everywhere in code (injection, poll, README), but main.odin's draw-site comment says "F-key" and the frozen spec's task list and verification still say Key_Press{.F} / "F toggles the panel" — someone following the spec's check would test a dead key.
recommended_fix: Fix the main.odin comment to "D-key" and correct the spec's .F injection and "F toggles the panel" lines to D.

title: noc_panel_rows overcounts rows vs draw_noc_panel, loosening the scroll clamp
detail: Measure counts all classes and always 4 sel_pipe rows; draw skips out-of-roster classes (continue without counting) and emits nothing when pipe_slot/find fails. total overestimates, so clamp(scroll_in, 0, total-visible) permits scrolling into blank space — despite the "MUST agree row-for-row" comment.
recommended_fix: Mirror the draw predicates in noc_panel_rows: count only in-roster classes and add sel_pipe rows only when the pipe slot resolves.

title: crisis_last_class is written and tested but never rendered
evidence:
+	crisis_last_class: u16,
+		f.crisis_last_class = e.class
+		line := fmt.tprintf("Saturated_Bundle %d  b%d p%d", feed.crisis_sat, feed.crisis_last_bundle, feed.crisis_last_pipe)
detail: The field is folded in noc_feed_fold_crisis and asserted in noc_feed_crisis_counts, but the panel line prints only sat/bundle/pipe — production never reads it. Dead state under the "zero dead code" banner.
recommended_fix: Either surface the class in the Saturated_Bundle line (cls=%d) or drop the field and its test assertion.

title: Release-footprint claims contradict each other across README, spec, and overlay header
evidence:
+tools/run-dev.sh        # play with the debug surface: D toggles the NOC drop-diagnosis panel (PP_DEBUG build; release builds carry zero overlay code)
+- **Ungated feed, gated draws:** ... Release carries an inert ~9 KB accumulator; every draw/input path stays under `when #config(PP_DEBUG, false)`.
+// carry an inert ~13 KB struct.
detail: README claims release carries "zero overlay code" while the feed/scan/labels are deliberately ungated; the spec says ~9 KB, the file header ~13 KB (struct arithmetic favors ~13 KB). Three inconsistent statements of one tradeoff.
recommended_fix: Standardize: release carries zero overlay DRAW code plus an inert ~13 KB feed; fix README wording and the spec's 9 KB figure.

title: Panel violates its own type ladder: 22px numerals in 16px rows, off-ladder 12px text
evidence:
+NOC_ROW_H   :: 16 // >= 14px body text + breathing (the 5.8 legibility rule)
+		noc_col(v, fmt.tprintf("%d", feed.drop_e9), 22, NOC_RED, head_lbl_r + 8, y)
+	cur = noc_row(v, cur, scroll, visible, hash, 12, NOC_LABEL_DIM)
+hierarchy — 10px uppercase labels, >=14px body (the 5.8 QoS-panel legibility convention), 22px headline numerals
detail: The mandated 22px headline numerals are placed in a 16px row pitch (noc_row_y advances 16px), so the DROPS row overlaps the ratio line below; several rows use 12px, a size the ruling's 10/14+ ladder never defines.
recommended_fix: Give the headline row a taller pitch (or reduce to 14-16px numerals) and move 12px items to the 10px label or 14px body tier.

title: AC3 diff command compares the capped 'ticks' header line, so it fails unless ms covers the full demo
evidence:
wall_max := min(u64(max(0, i64(cap_ms) * i64(hz) / 1000)), total_wall)
+		append(&hashes, h) // the AC3 stream proof (the blessed .t1 comparison)
+- `tools/harness.sh build && tools/harness.sh run` then `bin/harness-debug overlay-check <demo> <ms>` -- expected: ... and `diff <(tail -n +7 bin/overlay-<demo>-<ms>.t1) <(tail -n +7 goldens/<demo>.t1)` empty
 	fmt.sbprintf(&sb, "t1 1
demo %s
seed %d
logic_hz %d
catalog_hash %016x
ticks %d
",
detail: The sidecar's hash count is wall_max, capped by cap_ms; tail -n +7 keeps line 7 ("ticks %d") in the comparison, so any ms shorter than the demo's full wall yields a non-empty diff despite identical streams.
recommended_fix: Compare from line 8 (hash lines only) or assert sidecar length equals the golden's tick count before diffing.

title: Draw path performs per-frame temp-arena allocations despite the spec's "no per-frame allocations" constraint
detail: Every panel row fmt.tprintf's and noc_col clones a cstring per numeral per frame via MeasureTextEx; the code concedes the allocations. The spec's "no per-frame allocations (fixed arrays only)" line is contradicted as written.
recommended_fix: Either amend the spec constraint to "no persistent allocations; temp-arena allowed (HUD convention)" or cache the measured widths.

title: Acceptance-mandated KYLE verdict and cmp proof are not present in the diff
detail: The spec makes the KYLE readability verdict and the cmp/diff golden proof part of acceptance ("a DEFECTS verdict blocks"), yet the diff ships only three PNG captures under _bmad-output/pr-bodies/ — no verdict record or comparison output accompanies them.
recommended_fix: Commit the KYLE verdict line and the cmp output alongside the captures, or mark those ACs explicitly pending.
